description: This file defines a virtual class 'CKEDITOR.pluginDefinition' used for illustrating plugin object features within CKEditor. It contains documentation for properties and methods related to plugin initialization and dependencies, serving as a reference for plugin authors.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.pluginDefinition
classes.description: A virtual class that describes the features of plugin objects to be passed to CKEDITOR.plugins.add. It is not part of the actual API but serves for documentation and illustration purposes.

methods.name: beforeInit
methods.description: Function called before the init() call for each plugin when an editor instance is created. Used for initialization tasks dependent on other plugins.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Function called during the initialization of each editor instance. Used to set up plugin-specific features or behaviors.
